description: Op-shaped job that walks the live Dagster asset graph and enriches existing Castor (CastorDoc / Coalesce Catalog) tables with Dagster-sourced descriptions, tags, data-quality signal, and lineage edges.

tags.label: Job Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags as key-value pairs.

catalog_url.label: Castor Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: Castor/Coalesce Catalog GraphQL endpoint. EU tenants use api.castordoc.com (default); US tenants use https://api.us.castordoc.com/public/graphql.

api_token_env.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env.description: Env var holding the Castor API token (sent as Token header, not Bearer).

push_tags.label: Push Tags
push_tags.description: Attach dagster / dagster:group:<group> / dagster:kind:<kind> tags onto matched Castor tables via attachTags.

push_data_quality.label: Push Data Quality
push_data_quality.description: Push a best-effort 'tracked by Dagster' presence record via upsertDataQualities on each matched table. Not a real test result.

push_lineage_edges.label: Push Lineage Edges
push_lineage_edges.description: Push lineage edges via upsertLineages for asset-graph edges where both endpoints already resolve to an existing Castor table.

only_export_on_change.label: Only Export on Change
only_export_on_change.description: Hash the structural payload and skip push when unchanged from the previous successful run.

fail_on_catalog_error.label: Fail on Catalog Error
fail_on_catalog_error.description: If true, fail the run when the catalog is unreachable or mutations error. Default true.
